core_mechanic: Real-time combat plus persistent stat / equipment growth.

essential_feel.combat: telegraphed enemy windups, parries reward timing
essential_feel.progression: visible stat gains, gear with build identity

pacing_profile.early: Core combo + dodge online; loot rarely.
pacing_profile.mid: Build identity emerges; first ability tree node choices.

progression_model.completion_definition: Main story credits; true ending behind optional bosses; NG+ and prestige loops extend skill ceiling.
progression_model.content_cadence: Per zone / per ability tree node; gear and abilities drip every 30-60 minutes of play.

canonical_examples.title: Hades
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Run-based pacing welded to persistent narrative progression.

anti_patterns: Damage sponge enemies without behaviour variety
Loot inflation that obsoletes builds within minutes
Bosses that punish learning without checkpointing
